issues.desc: background.md Key Insights + description both state LEGACY_KOALA_DIR is used in ~6 files, but a grep of packages/main/src shows 10 unique consumer files: cli-engine.ts, audit-config.ts, rollout-check.ts, dev-memory.ts, planner.ts, store.ts, activity-log.ts, evidence-freshness.ts, story-query.ts, doctor.ts. CHK-001 mitigates this by instructing the implementer to grep, but the stated blast radius is materially understated and could mislead scope/effort estimation.
